questions.q: What is the problem with the flea market in Pančevo?
questions.e: In the video: "Problem sa buvljakom u Pančevu je što nema određeni prostor za buvljak." — the problem with the flea market in Pančevo is that it has no designated space.

questions.q: What incredible thing did she find?
questions.e: In the video: "Znači, ja sam našla moju torbu i to mora da je moja torba" — so I found my bag and it must be my bag.

questions.q: What was the bag originally?
questions.e: In the video: "ovo nije bila ni torba, ovo je bila suknja, kožna." — it wasn't even a bag, it was a skirt, a leather one.

questions.q: Why did she throw the bag away?
o: It can't be sold or given away
questions.e: In the video: "ja sam je bacila jer to ne može da se proda" — I threw it away because it can't be sold.

questions.q: How can labels show the things are good?
questions.e: In the video: "Ako odmah vidim neke stare etikete, znači da su dobre stvari tu." — if I immediately see some old labels, it means good things are there.

questions.q: What does she advise about haggling?
o: Haggle only at the end of the day
questions.e: In the video: "Prva cena, ne." — the first price, no.

questions.q: How much did the candlesticks cost?
questions.e: In the video: "Četiri komada, 600 dinara." — four pieces, 600 dinars.

questions.q: What can you do on the first weekend of the month?
o: Put out large waste by the container
questions.e: In the video: "svakog prvog vikenda u mesecu možete takođe izbaciti neki malo veći otpad na kontejner" — every first weekend of the month you can put out some larger waste into the container.
